verdict.rationale: WorkOS AuthKit Connect documents OAuth applications for third parties that show a "Sign in with [your application]" button, covering user-facing web, mobile, desktop and CLI clients. AuthKit is described as a spec-compatible OAuth authorization server with built-in support for OAuth applications, and M2M credentials are offered for partners. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and detailed evidence on token issuance, scopes and consent screens for third-party clients.
